question: Estimate monthly demand for premium watches (₹50K+) in a Tier 1 city like Hyderabad.
idealClarificationQuestions: Premium watches ₹50K+ (Tag Heuer, Tissot premium, Omega entry, Rolex, Cartier)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Affluent population × annual premium watch buyers × monthly distribution.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian luxury watch market: ₹6,500-7,000 Cr/year (per Marketing Q63).
